claims.text: The Recovery of Premises Act sets no limit on how much rent a landlord may demand in advance in the FCT, and attaches no penalty to demanding more than a year.
An Abuja landlord asking for two years’ rent on 5 November 2026 is not breaking any law, and no authority exists to order a refund.
Your landlord can legally demand more than a year's rent.
What you agree is what counts, so get it in writing.

post.headline: Why your Abuja landlord can ask for two years' rent upfront
lines: Tunde, moving to Abuja? Your landlord can legally demand more than a year's rent.
The Recovery of Premises Act sets no limit on advance rent in the FCT.
Even with a bill proposing a cap, an Abuja landlord asking for two years today is not breaking any law.
What you agree is what counts, so get it in writing.

threads.text: Tunde, new to Abuja? Your landlord can legally ask for more than one year's rent upfront. The Recovery of Premises Act sets no limit on advance rent in the FCT. Even a pending bill doesn't change this today. What do you think about this rule?
threads.evening: In Abuja, the Recovery of Premises Act sets no cap on advance rent. A pending bill proposes a 12-month limit, but it's not law yet.
